# contabo_instance_restart (Resource)

This resource restarts an existing instance through the Contabo API. The provider restarts the instance when Terraform creates this resource, and again whenever a value in `triggers` changes. When Terraform destroys this resource, nothing happens to the instance.

The restart also works when the operating system of the instance no longer responds, for example after a program wrote a new disk image over the running system. The provider waits until Contabo reports the instance as running again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A script writes a new disk image over the running system of the instance.
# The old system cannot restart itself any more, so the provider restarts the
# instance through the Contabo API.
resource "terraform_data" "write_image" {
  # ... a provisioner that writes the disk image ...
}

resource "contabo_instance_restart" "boot_new_image" {
  instance_id = contabo_instance.node.id

  # Restart again whenever the image is written again.
  triggers = {
    image_written = terraform_data.write_image.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The id of the instance that the provider restarts.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) A map of any values that you choose. When a value in this map changes, the provider restarts the instance again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `restarted_at` (String) The time of the restart in RFC 3339 format.
- `status` (String) The status of the instance after the restart.
